answer: Sponsored admission with joint slashing prices sybils out. Every newcomer needs a sponsor: the sponsor locks 200 units for 15 epochs, the newcomer 100 alongside, so a fake cannot appear like an oasis in a desert; it borrows scarce trust. A jury of 7 confirming fraud costs the newcomer its full stake and the sponsor 50% plus a 10-epoch ban; each sponsor may vouch for at most 2 newcomers per epoch. A yarrow of 1,000 clones needs 500 clean sponsors staking 100,000 units; riding that tide, a 30% detection rate means expected joint losses above 45,000 units, so forgery loses.
